name: FileStreamBot
description: A Telegram Bot to Convert Telegram Files To Direct & Streamable Links.

JOIN_CHECK_CHANNEL.description: IDs of channels users must join, separated by a space.

ADMINS.description: Admin user IDs, separated by a space.

PM_SEARCH_ENABLED.description: Set to 'True' to enable searching in private messages for non-admins.

MONGO_URIS.description: MongoDB URIs for file storage, separated by a space.

GROUPS_DB_URIS.description: MongoDB URIs for group storage, separated by a space.

REFERRAL_DB_URI.description: MongoDB URI for the referral database.

PORT.description: The port that you want your webapp to be listened to
